data.name: Aniruddhsinh
data.gender_notes: Aniruddhsinh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ani- (Ani- Rudra) meaning 'Rudra's', Sinh- (Sinh Asvatthama) meaning 'Lion'. The name Aniruddhsinh is a combination of Aniruddha and Sinh. Aniruddha is a name of Lord Krishna who was the son of Lord Krishna and Rukmini. Sinh is a royal and powerful name derived from the lion. This name suggests the strength and courage of a king and the wisdom of a god.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aniruddhsinh is a name that represents the divine power and courage of Lord Krishna, combined with the royal and powerful traits of the lion. It is a name that inspires strength, courage, and wisdom in those who bear it.
data.etymology: Aniruddhsinh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ani- Rudra's Lord, Sinh- Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aniruddhsinh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name reflects the inner strength and wisdom that comes from connecting with the divine source of knowledge and power.
